text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"Please let me train with you today!
I'm sure that, just like the two of you, I can achieve stellar results—"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I'll draw it out with a hammer throw...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
No need to feel pressured, it's totally fine!
It counts as independent training for me too, so I'm grateful.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
That's right!
My Princess Arms are itching for action~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Hoo, hoo... huff!
Come on, come on! Don't loosen your grip on the horizontal bar!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *pant*...
My hands and arms... are burning up!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Indeed, pull-ups really are two birds with one stone! I've learned something today!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Nnh...
The vest inside is... really heavy...!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Yes! By hiking, you will accustom your body to the weight of that iron ball!
Once you do, the iron ball will—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Zero Princess Gravity!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I see...! All right, I'm not done yet!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Muscles are built from ingredients!
I'm gonna make a smoothie with high-protein foods!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore! To train my princess power,
I shall not use a blender! What I will use is—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"These fists!! Right!
First up, this Mr. Broccoli!"
(Crack☆ Crunch crunch crunch――★)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Putting all the fruits of my training into this!
...1, 2, 3... MUSCLEEEE!!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Waaah! The iron ball went so far away...!
A whooosh to set a new personal best!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that was a splendid hammer throw.
I guess there's nothing left for me to teach you.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Yes, yes! You are already
a splendid, powerful princess!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
~~gh...! Thank you so, so much!
I won't forget this favor—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: No... I will never forget these muscles!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Flower.
Are you heading out too?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Yes! To training,
and volunteering at the recycling center.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Tearing thick magazines right in half with my bare hands,
or crushing steel cans with a satisfying crunch...♪

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Huh.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. I'll make sure to train my muscles today too,
and help some people out along the way!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Hum-hum-hum♪
Muscle, muscle~...♪
